SELECT id, subject_short, subject_full, customer_type, cert_expire, quota_total, quota_used, contact_valid_date, creator, phone, remark, create_time, update_time FROM we_corp WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM we_corp
AND subject_short IN
#{s}
AND (
customer_type = #{c} OR customer_type LIKE CONCAT('%', #{c}, ',%') OR customer_type LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{c}, ',%') OR customer_type LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{c}, '%')
)
AND (subject_short LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR subject_full LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR creator LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO we_corp (subject_short, subject_full, customer_type, cert_expire, quota_total, quota_used, contact_valid_date, creator, phone, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{subjectShort}, #{subjectFull}, #{customerType}, #{certExpire}, #{quotaTotal}, #{quotaUsed}, #{contactValidDate}, #{creator}, #{phone}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
